newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: New Star shares down on tender offer.
newsitem.headline: New Star shares down on tender offer.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's New Star Trading Co fell 3,100 won to 59,000 in Thursday morning trading despite Savoy Hotel's offer to buy 25.3 percent of New Star's shares in a takeover bid, brokers said.
"This is a longstanding 'buy on rumours, sell on news' pattern," said a Hyundai Securities broker.
"Many people think those willing to join the stake war have already secured enough, and so there's little benefit for them to join now."
Savoy on Thursday offered to buy 120,785 shares of New Star for 62,500 won per share after receiving tenders May 6-26.
If successful, Savoy's stake in the garment maker would rise to 50 percent from the current 24.7 percent.
